dialogue.intro: Hi, I'm a frontend developer. I usually live somewhere between React, Next.js and TypeScript.
dialogue.interfaces: I build admin panels and complex interfaces. The more tables, filters, forms, maps and strange states they have, the more interesting it gets.
dialogue.experience: I've worked on transport services, fintech, builders, real-time systems, payments and even legacy code that was better left undisturbed.
dialogue.craft: Most of all, I enjoy building things from scratch: from UI kits and architecture to screens that people actually use.
dialogue.projects: When commercial interfaces aren't enough, I make my own projects — games and anything that lets me go beyond yet another form with a Save button.
dialogue.education: Somewhere along the way, I earned a university degree and brought my English up to B2. The rest is easier to show than to list.
